notes.title: Konami stops PES 2019 in-game currency sales in Belgium
notes.notes:
Konami has announced that it's halting the sale of Pro Evolution Soccer 2019's in-game currency in Belgium.

The sale of myClub Coins will cease across all platforms once the 'necessary preparations are made.' Any previously purchased myClub Coins can be used as normal and the currency will continue to be rewarded for playing the game but players will no longer be able to purchase them with real money.

"We fully respect the BGC's interpretation of relevant laws and made the decision to implement local changes to "PES 2019" in Belgium," said Konami in its statement.

Konami is the latest publisher to take action following the Belgian Gaming Commission's report referring to Loot Boxes in games as a form of gambling. CS:GO disabled loot boxes last summer and Blizzard pulled paid loot boxes from Overwatch and Heroes of the Storm shortly after. More recently, EA withdrew FIFA Points sales in Belgium at the end of last month.

It doesn't appear that any direct action was taken by the BGC against Konami at this point. However, last year's investigation into EA—which appears to have led to the recent removal of FIFA 19's currency sales—may have prompted the decision.

notes.title: [Official] Issues Under Investigation
notes.notes:
Dear loyal customers,

This is a KONAMI/PES developer account.

This is an update regarding the following issues currently being encountered by some users:

[b]・An issue where the screen turns white and the game subsequently crashes[/b]
[b]・An issue where users are unable to connect to the server and the “CODE:VNBP733” error is displayed[/b]

Following our updates and investigations, we can see the majority of users are no longer encountering the above issues.

As a thanks for your help and apology for the errors, a goodwill gesture is planned to be distributed by end of this week.

If you are still encountering these issues, they might be caused by your PC environment. Therefore, please try out the methods listed below.
If you do not find any improvement, please send an inquiry via our official website.

EU https://www.konami.com/wepes/2019/ask/2019/eu/en/pc/
US https://www.konami.com/wepes/2019/ask/2019/us/en-us/pc/

[u][b]How to fix the screen white-out/game crash issue[/b][/u]

 In case of using Windows 7, please apply the latest service pack.
 Use the links listed below to install all the necessary runtime libraries.

<Runtime Libraries Needed  for PES 2019>
[olist]
[*]DirectX End-User Runtimes (June 2010)  :directx_Jun2010_redist.exe
 https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=8109

[*]Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015 :vc_redist.x64.exe
 https://www.microsoft.com/en-US/download/details.aspx?id=48145

[*]The .NET Framework 4.6.2 offline installer for Windows :NDP462-KB3151800-x86-x64-AllOS-ENU.exe
 https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/3151800/the-net-framework-4-6-2-offline-installer-for-windows
[/olist]

[u][b]How to fix the error Code VNBP733 issue that prevents you from logging into the server[/b][/u]

Please make sure that PES 2019 connection is not blocked any program such as anti-virus software.
Ensure PES 2019 is not being blocked by Windows Defender or Windows Firewall (detailed procedure below)

＜How to ensure that Windows Defender is not blocking PES 2019＞

Windows 10
[olist]
[*]Open Windows Defender.
[*]Go to the Firewall & Network Protection tab.
[*]Open Advanced Settings.
[*]Click on the Inbound Rules tab on the left side of the window.
[*]Scroll down till you find Pro Evolution Soccer 2019.
[*]Click the game in the list to highlight it.
[*]Click Disable Rule on the right side of the screen.
[/olist]
Windows 7
[olist]
[*]Go to Control Panel > Windows Firewall.
[*]Open Advanced Settings.
[*]Click on the Inbound Rules tab on the left side of the window.
[*]Click Pro Evolution Soccer 2019.
[*]Click Disable Rule on the right side of the screen.
[/olist]
Once again, we sincerely apologise for any inconvenience caused by these issues and thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: [Official] Error code VNBP733 update
notes.notes:
Dear loyal customers,

This is a KONAMI/PES developer account.

Firstly, we sincerely apologise for all the inconveniences caused by error code VNBP733.

We're further investigating the issue at this very moment and to help with this would like to ask you to follow the two steps below.

[u][b]I. Details on firewall setting (Windows 10)[/b][/u]

This is similar to the information we posted on our official PES 2019 website a few days ago, but as the process is slightly complicated have provided supplementary images this time too.
[olist]
[*]Open Windows Defender.
[*]Go to the Firewall & Network Protection tab.
[*]Open Advanced Settings.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32755059/363f1ba0022776bf7a56716dae2bb3143b513dea.png[/img]
[*]Click on the Inbound Rules tab on the left side of the window.
[*]Scroll down till you find Pro Evolution Soccer 2019.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32755059/527726315895390ceece3b7e40c09c96e4448b88.png[/img]
[*]Click the game in the list to highlight it.
[*]Click Disable Rule on the right side of the screen.
[/olist]
If you can still not connect after going through the process above, please kindly follow the second step (packet capture) below.

[u][b]II. Packet capture[/b][/u]
[olist]
[*]Install the latest version of 'Wireshark' on the PC which PES 2019 is installed.
   https://www.wireshark.org
[*]Boot PES 2019, then proceed to the title screen, and leave it on that screen (the screen with Coutinho image）
[*]Boot Wireshark, highlight the item under the "... using this filter" of "Capture" on "Welcome to Wireshark" screen.
　 In normal case, "Ethernet" will be shown. If the multiple choices are shown, please choose "interface" that you use.]
[*]Select "Capture" from the top tabs, then click "Start" to start capturing.
[*]Try login to server on PES 2019.
[*]If "CODE:VNBP733" error is shown on your PES 2019, please select "Capture" from the top tabs and click "Stop" to stop the capturing process.
[*]Select "File" and click "Save". Please name the file as VNBP733 in pcapng file (pcapng is a default setting). 
[*]Please send the pcapng file, and OS information (Windows 10, Windows 7, etc.) to us.
[/olist]
Please submit the captured files and OS information below.
 EU https://www.konami.com/wepes/2019/ask/2019/eu/en/pc/
 US https://www.konami.com/wepes/2019/ask/2019/us/en-us/pc/

Once again, we apologise for the issue and assure you that with the data you provide we are working hard to solve this issue as soon as possible.

Thank you so much for you support and understanding.

KONAMI/PES Team
